patthana8.49:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca no kileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, no kilesaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na no kileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. no kilesaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca no kiloso ca na no kileso ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana8.49:2.1: na no kilesaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na kileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. tīṇi,
patthana8.49:3.1: no kilesaṃ ca na no kilesaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca no kileso dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā, tīṇi,
patthana8.49:4.1: hetuyā nava, sabbattha nava. na saṃkilesikaṃ
